notes: First-pass world-coordinate approach gates extracted from a real ACC Spa run. Runtime should use car_world_x/car_world_z and trigger when entering each gate radius. Coordinates are ACC world coordinates, not image pixels.

gates.label: T1 La Source
gates.message: Approaching Turn 1 La Source: brake in one firm hit, release as you turn, delay full throttle until the car points toward exit.

gates.label: T3 Eau Rouge
gates.message: Approaching Turn 3 Eau Rouge: after Turn 2, settle the car, hold one steering angle, avoid a panic lift.

gates.label: T5, T6, T7 Les Combes/Malmedy
gates.message: Approaching Turn 5, then Turn 6 and Turn 7 Les Combes/Malmedy: brake once at the end of Kemmel, release before turn-in, use the first right-hand apex to set up the left.

gates.label: T8, T9 Bruxelles
gates.message: Approaching Turn 8, then Turn 9 Bruxelles: keep light brake pressure past turn-in, then wait for rotation before throttle.

gates.label: T10, T11 No Name
gates.message: Approaching Turn 10, then Turn 11 No Name: finish the small lift early, then commit with one smooth steering input.

gates.label: T12, T13 Pouhon/Fagnes
gates.message: Approaching Turn 12, then Turn 13 Pouhon/Fagnes: keep the first left flowing; do not add throttle if steering is still increasing.

gates.label: T14, T15 Campus/Stavelot
gates.message: Approaching Turn 14, then Turn 15 Campus/Stavelot: sacrifice entry if needed, straighten early, then go full throttle for the long exit.

gates.label: T18, T19 Bus Stop
gates.message: Approaching Turn 18, then Turn 19 Bus Stop: brake hard while straight, release for rotation, prioritize second apex exit.
